newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks ease in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks ease in London trading.

text.p: Japanese shares were sightly lower in light London trading on Friday, with shares in major electrical and electronic groups providing the main interest, traders said.
London's Nikkei 50 index was down 11.28 points at 1,415.33 by 1415 GMT.

In Tokyo the Nikkei 225 index fell for the fifth day in a row, closing 263.52 points down at 20,739.97, with investor sentiment affected by uncertainties over the new coalition government and the pace of growth in the domestic economy.
Traders said the London market had been quiet although shares could make a recovery next week. "The Nikkei 225 has fallen five days in a row and there is always room for a bounce," said one.
Buying interest in selected electronics stocks after interim earnings announcements provided the main point of interest, traders said.
By 1415 GMT Toshiba shares traded at 743-1/2 yen, up 10-1/2 yen on their Tokyo close. NEC shares traded at 1,222-1/2 yen, up 2-1/2 yen.
